neighbours.label: the token ' personally' (someone doing something themselves)
fire: The mayor personally thanked every volunteer at the shelter.
After the complaint, the manager personally called the customer back.
I personally think the second draft reads much better.
Our chef personally selects the fish at the harbor each dawn.
The general personally led the charge across the river.
She personally signed each of the five hundred invitations.
The author will personally answer questions after the reading.
He told me he personally checked every line of the contract.
quiet: The mayor warmly thanked every volunteer at the shelter.
After the complaint, the manager quickly called the customer back.
I honestly think the second draft reads much better.
Our chef carefully selects the fish at the harbor each dawn.
